title: Network view Phase 0 guardrails
summary: Prepared Phase 0 guardrails and baseline evidence for the Network View troubleshooting refactor without moving production Network code.
reason: The planned split of networkView.js needs export, caller, route, DOM, and command-owner baselines plus source-only guardrails that can inspect the parent facade and future child assets before extraction starts.

behavior_after: Phase 0 tests and tooling understand the parent-plus-existing-child Network asset set while networkView.js remains the only public facade and current command owner.
